description:
## Problem
Every trust test proves the gate never says "verified" wrongly. None proves it ever says "verified" through the real CLI and engine. The published corpus has zero `applied_verified` bundles ever. The cited "full flow" test used a schema production never creates.

## Change
Add `tests/integration/tuning/test_tuning_liveness_e2e.py`. It drives the real `benchbox run` CLI at SF 0.01 with result anonymization disabled in the test, and asserts:
- **DuckDB, custom sort-only config:** `applied_verified`, 0 mismatch, 0 dropped.
- **DuckDB, shipped tpch/ssb/tpcds tuned templates:** `applied_verified`.
- **chDB, custom sort+partition config:** `applied_verified`.
- **Status matrix** over {duckdb, sqlite, datafusion, clickhouse-local, polars} × {tpch, ssb, tpcds} × {tuned, notuning, auto}:
  - exit code 0 everywhere;
  - pinned `validation_status` per cell;
  - no `mismatch` verdicts.

Also install the `zstd` CLI in the CI image; datagen silently produced empty manifests without it.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Never relax an assertion to make it pass. A red cell is a defect to fix or an explicit, documented expected status.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
